data.outcome_summary: This OECD PISA 2022 factsheet summarizes performance and equity-related patterns for Chinese Taipei using the PISA 2022 assessment of 15-year-old students in mathematics, reading, and science. Students took two two-hour tests, with different students receiving different combinations of subject test questions, and all students completed a background questionnaire; school principals also completed a questionnaire. The factsheet reports mean performance trends (2018 vs. 2022; and 2006–2022), proficiency-level shares (e.g., Level 2+ and Level 5/6), and within-country gaps by socio-economic status (ESCS quintiles and top/bottom 25%) and by gender. It also highlights school climate and learning-support indicators (e.g., teacher interest, extra help, disciplinary climate, digital distraction) and COVID-related learning experiences. Uncertainty is communicated via 95% confidence intervals, and an asterisk would indicate sampling-standard issues; Chinese Taipei is stated to meet quality standards.
